# Matteo Baldelli

> Computer Vision & AI Engineer based in Bergamo, Lombardy, Italy.
> Available for industrial vision, AI and intelligent systems projects in Bergamo, Brescia, Lombardy and beyond.

## Identity

- Name: Matteo Baldelli
- Role: Computer Vision & AI Engineer
- Education: Master's degree in Physics, University of Pavia (Università degli Studi di Pavia)
- Location: Bergamo, Italy
- Service area: Bergamo, Brescia, Lombardy (Lombardia), Italy
- Languages: Italian, English

## What he does

Matteo Baldelli designs and develops industrial computer vision and AI systems end to end: cameras, optics and lighting, algorithms, line integration and production deployment. He has contributed to 40+ vision systems, mainly in biomedical, automotive and pharmaceutical sectors.

He also builds RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) platforms and analyzes company processes to find bottlenecks and accelerate work with AI.

## Selected projects

- Industrial seals (torsional damper): X-ray algorithms for internal defects (bubbles, missing material) and laser-scanner algorithms for external defects (cuts, tears, cosmetic defects), through production deployment
- Biomedical: bacteria detection algorithms on Petri dishes
- Industry: sintering line automation with three collaborative robots

## Technology interests

- Vision-Language Models (VLM)
- Vision-Language-Action (VLA), embodied AI, humanoid robotics
- SLAM, autonomous systems and drones
- Robotics and AI in agriculture
